items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s also on a piece – he’s also on a record I did with Atlantic Records that Chick wrote, a trio for bassoon, piano, and flute.

ctx.x: You also had Fred Alston on bassoon.
Yeah, that’s right. He’s also on a piece – he’s also on a record I did with Atlantic Records that Chick wrote, a trio for bassoon, piano, and flute.
